entry.title: Practical Bridesmaid Gift Ideas for Every Budget
entry.summary: Need some inspiration on what to get your bridesmaids when you ask…
entry.content:
Need some inspiration on what to get your bridesmaids when you ask them to be apart of your big day? Don't pick out the typical items with "bridesmaid" plastered all over it!  First things first, gifts aren't necessary! Something as simple as a heart felt note is just as amazing as a expensive tote bag.  Here are some ideas that your bridesmaids will be so appreciative of!

Gift Guide 🛒

💰Under $5:

Personalized Notes

A note can be such a great way to tell your besties how much they mean to you and it is so nice on your pocket book! Here is an Etsy template that you can purchase and print off at home or through a local print shop!
 

Hair Ties or Clips

One can never have too many hair ties! Your bridesmaids will find these so helpful, especially as they pack for the bachelorette party and the wedding day! Find these two items on etsy, both under $5! 

 

 

💰💰Under $15:

Wine

Are you surrounded by a bunch of whinos? Then this is a great gift for your bridesmaids. They will appreciate it if you find their favorite kind and apply this custom decal that you can stick on a bottle of wine!
 
 

Jewelry

What a great way to pick out earrings or bracelets that you want them to wear on the wedding day and other occasions after that! This is a great gift that can be used for multiple things! Check out this bracelet from PAVOI on amazon!

 

 

💰💰💰Under $30:

Pajamas or Loungewear

Another multi-use item that your bridesmaids will love is comfy clothes! Your getting ready photos will look cohesive and your bridesmaids get another set of pajamas to have! Here is a couple cute sets on amazon!

 

       

 

Makeup or Products

What are your favorite makeup items or products? There is a good chance that your bridesmaids will like it too! They will be great for events leading up to your big day! Just make sure no new products are used too close to wedding day!

 

 

💰💰💰💰Under $50:

Gift Cards for a Mani-Pedi

What better way to help your bridesmaids prep for the big day or bachelorette party! Treat them to a relaxing day of manicures or pedicures.  It's not only a great gift, but also a great way to bond and celebrate!

 

Perfume

Another amazing gift that they can use for a long time and every-time they use it they will think of you! Perfumes can be spendy, but there are travel sizes, roll-on's, and more options to help fit your budget!

 

 

💰💰💰💰💰Under $100:

Monogrammed Garment Bag

Keep all of your bridesmaid dresses safe and easy to transport with this adorable monogrammed garment bag! Your "I do" crew will appreciate this stylish and useful bag.  Not a bad idea for your groomsmen as well!

 

Hair & Makeup on the Wedding Day

Getting your hair and makeup done for the wedding day can get a little spendy.  I am sure your bridesmaids would love some help with these services.  Especially if they are in multiple weddings this wedding season!
